item.title: Trump trade chief defiant on Supreme Court ruling, vows to restore tariffs within months
item.description: The Supreme Court struck down Trump’s tariff authority, but the administration says it will revive the program using other trade laws.

item.title: Iran regime 'about to collapse,' Prince Reza Pahlavi says as economic crisis deepens
item.description: Former crown prince Pahlavi says Iran's ruling regime is "on its last leg" and calls for maximum pressure to trigger democratic transition in the country.

item.title: Mortgage rates fall below 6% for first time since 2022
item.description: The average rate on a 30-year fixed mortgage fell this week to 5.98%, according to the latest Freddie Mac data released Thursday. That is down from last week's reading of 6.01%.

item.title: Cheese sold at Walmart recalled in 24 states over potential health risk
item.description: Great Value cottage cheese recalled at Walmart stores across 24 states due to pasteurization concerns. No illnesses have been reported yet from this recall.

item.title: FTC chair touts ‘huge win for American workers’ after Walmart agrees to $100M settlement over driver pay
item.description: Walmart agrees to $100 million FTC settlement over allegations it deceived delivery drivers about pay and tips, allegedly affecting millions of workers nationwide.

item.title: Americans hit with soaring electricity bills as price hikes outpace inflation nationwide
item.description: Electricity prices surged 6.3% nationwide as AI data centers and winter weather strained the grid, outpacing inflation and hitting household budgets hard.

item.title: Ford recalls over 4.3 million vehicles due to software issue
item.description: Ford recalls 4.3 million vehicles over a software problem that could cause trailer brake failure and a loss of exterior lights when towing.

item.title: Florida man arrested over alleged $328M crypto Ponzi scheme
item.description: An accused crypto fraudster used investor funds for parties and luxury travel, prosecutors said after federal charges were filed in analleged $328 million Ponzi scheme targeting investors.

item.title: Netflix backs out of Warner Bros bidding war after Paramount made 'superior' offer
item.description: Warner Bros. Discovery announced its board of directors determined Paramount's latest bid to buy the entire company is "superior" to Netflix's offer for the movie studio and HBO.

item.title: FedEx says it will return any tariff refunds to customers, shippers who paid them
item.description: FedEx said it will return any tariff refunds it receives to the shippers and customers who paid them after Trump's IEEPA tariffs were struck down as illegal.
